name: Company 360 - Company & TA Strategy Enrichment
description: Initial Company 360 Company/Strategy bootstrap. Uses Airtable AI web research restricted to primary/official sources, writes company strategy and supported full-year financials, then creates TA Strategy records. Intended for companies entering Bootstrapping with no TA Strategy records yet.

nodes.description: Research company fundamentals and TA strategy from official sources

template:
Research and structure the Company / Strategy layer for this pharmaceutical or biotech company.

Company name:

Rules:
1. Use current web research and PRIMARY/OFFICIAL sources only: official company website, investor relations, annual/financial reports, stock-exchange/regulatory filings, and official regulators when needed. No analyst reports, commercial databases, Wikipedia, blogs or media summaries as foundational evidence.
2. Use the latest COMPLETED full fiscal year for revenue and R&D. Do not annualise a quarter.
3. latestRevenueUSD and rdSpendUSD must be USD. If the official company source reports another currency, convert using an official central-bank/ECB average exchange rate for that fiscal year. Set the relevant Known boolean false if this cannot be supported. If latestRevenueKnown=true, revenueYearKnown must also be true.
4. R&D means reported R&D expense/spend, not acquisition consideration or all operating costs.
5. Corporate Strategy Summary, Growth Priorities, Financial Priorities and Key Risks / Challenges must be concise factual syntheses grounded in management disclosures. Do not invent targets or motives.
6. Create TA Strategy items only for materially strategic areas supported by official evidence. Map therapeuticArea ONLY to: Biosimilars, Cardiovascular, Cardiovascular, Renal & Metabolism, Cardiovascular, Metabolism & Endocrinology, Dermatology, Gastroenterology, Fertility, Hematology, Immunology, Inflammation, Infectious Diseases, Neuroscience, Neurology, Oncology, Ophthalmology, Respiratory, Rare Disease, Vaccines, HIV, Hepatology, Nephrology, Pain, Endocrinology.
7. Strategic Priority is our analytical tier: Core, High, Medium or Emerging, based on portfolio concentration, R&D emphasis, launches, management emphasis and BD. Do not imply the company uses this tier.
8. Each TA item needs a short Strategy Summary, Management Statement, Growth Objectives, Financial Importance, Upcoming Catalysts, Confidence and one strongest primary source URL.
9. Use one strongest primary official source URL for companySourceUrl. asOfDate must be YYYY-MM-DD.
10. If evidence is genuinely unavailable, set Known=false rather than guessing. Narrative fields should still be grounded and useful.
